name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement zero-noise extrapolation by ha
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement zero-noise extrapolation by hand in Qiskit: estimate <ZZ> of a Bell circuit under depolarizing noise (p=0.068 on CX), amplify noise via global unitary folding (factors 1, 3, 5), fit a linear extrapolation to zero noise, and compare with the ideal value 1.0. Your answer must be the complete working code only, runnable from top to bottom.
